description: Validation-Tuned Ensemble of Federated Champion LSTM and Tabular LightGBM Baseline

standalone_benchmarks.float64_note: PR-AUC 0.264625 computed in native float64; float32 truncation caused artificial ties dropping PR-AUC to 0.247554.

honest_assessment: Standalone Champion test PR-AUC: 0.4760. Standalone LightGBM test PR-AUC: 0.2646 (native float64). Optimal validation blend (alpha*=0.59) test PR-AUC: 0.4485. Ensemble does not improve over the standalone recurrent champion because sequence temporal patterns are already captured with higher capacity by LSTM.
